title: Validate the Git storage publisher natively on Linux x86_64
goal: Record Linux x86_64 evidence for the T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1 publisher (local-snapshot, push-policy) on origin/main fd6739c63: focused bin tests, strict bin clippy, xtask format check and an end-to-end submit/status-main and cut/status/adopt exercise against a local bare-repository fixture, including a competing fast-forward and snapshot tag immutability. Evidence only; no publisher source is changed.
acceptance: On Linux x86_64 with pinned Rust 1.99.0, `cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --features release-tooling --bin local-snapshot` passes; evidence JSON records results.
checkpoint: Linux x86_64, Rust 1.99.0, fd6739c63: local-snapshot 26/26 passed (with and without release-tooling), strict bin clippy pass for local-snapshot and push-policy, cargo fmt -p xtask --check pass, cold build 36.4s, e2e against a local bare repo passed including a competing fast-forward (recomposed, no force) and snapshot tag immutability. push-policy bin has 0 unit tests. Claim path blocked by push-policy (see evidence).
claim_note: Claim attempted as grok and grok-publinux; refused by the repository pre-push policy (refs/claim-generation/current is an unsupported namespace in push-policy). Not bypassed. See evidence issue claim-blocked-by-push-policy.
dependency_note: Depends on T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1 source as present on origin/main fd6739c63 (not on that task closing). Recorded under validates because `susi tasks claim` refuses a task whose deps are still open, and this task produces the Linux evidence T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1 itself lists as pending.
